# peep — notes for GitHub Copilot

peep is a birdwatching PWA built for Hacktoberfest's "Touch Grass" challenge. Bird
identification runs **on the user's device** with open models; that is the point of
the project. When reviewing pull requests or writing code, hold to these rules.

## Non-negotiables

- **No cloud inference.** Photo ID uses the AIY Birds model via MediaPipe
  (`src/lib/photoId.ts`); sound ID uses BirdNET via TensorFlow.js in a Web Worker
  (`src/lib/birdnet.worker.ts`). Flag any PR that sends photos, audio or location to
  an external API.
- **Offline first.** Anything a user needs on a trail (models, field guide, app shell)
  must be cacheable by `public/sw.js` / `src/lib/offline.ts`. New runtime assets go
  under `/models`, `/mediapipe` or `/data`, or are bundled by Vite.
- **Privacy.** The Flock server (`server/index.mjs`) only receives species names,
  timestamps, stickers, and photos the user explicitly chose to share. Location
  never leaves the device; it is used only by the on-device BirdNET geo model and
  stored as a ~1 km cell for the Wanderer sticker.
- **Screen time stays short.** No infinite feeds, streaks that punish missed days,
  or notifications designed to pull people back. The flock feed ends with
  "You're all caught up".

## Conventions

- TypeScript + React 19, no UI framework. Styles live in `src/index.css` and use the
  palette tokens (`--parchment`, `--sand`, `--olive`, `--sage`, `--bark`,
  `--olivewood`). Headings use Cormorant Garamond, everything else Jost.
- No emojis in the UI; icons come from `src/components/Icons.tsx` (24×24 line art,
  `stroke="currentColor"`).
- UI copy is plain, friendly and human. Short sentences, no exclamation marks,
  no marketing tone.
- The server has zero dependencies (Node ≥ 22.13 built-in `node:sqlite`). Keep it
  that way; validate every input and keep queries parameterised.
- Field guide data (`public/data/species.json`) is generated by
  `scripts/build-species.mjs` and `scripts/gemma-facts.mjs`; don't hand-edit it.
- CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) must pass: `tsc -b`, `oxlint`, `vite build`, and
  the Flock API smoke test.
